verdict.rationale: Portkey exposes a documented REST API (base URL https://api.portkey.ai/v1) with API-reference docs for its inference API, OpenAI-compatible integration, and llms.txt discovery confirms API-first positioning; gateway is also open-sourced and npx-runnable. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent/third-party corroboration of API usage.
